visual_logic.composition: A professional 2x2 grid with thin divider lines. Ray-traced 3D rendering with deep shadows.
visual_logic.top_left_birth: A subterranean sandy burrow. Several leathery, off-white eggs are nestled in the sand. One hatchling Najash is emerging, its tiny hind legs twitching for the first time. Soft light filters from the burrow entrance.
visual_logic.top_right_dining: The Najash is coiled and striking at a 'Cronopio' (small mammal). The action is frozen in time with subtle motion blur on the snake's head. The 'dog-croc' (Araripesuchus) is visible as a distant, non-overlapping silhouette in the background to show ecological competition.
visual_logic.bottom_left_sleeping: The snake is coiled tightly into a 'S-shape' inside the cool, dark shade of a hollowed-out red sandstone rock. The matte texture of the rock contrasts with the slightly reflective, smooth scales of the snake.
visual_logic.bottom_right_playing: Two juvenile Najash are 'wrestling' in a shallow sand pit, their bodies intertwined. Their movements have kicked up a soft cloud of red dust, illuminated by a shaft of light.
visual_logic.rendering_notes: Use physical-based rendering (PBR) for the sand and scales. Ensure the two hind legs are rendered with anatomical precision in the Birth and Playing quadrants to emphasize this unique evolutionary feature.
